researchCountercheck.readSummary: The culture findings depend on timing, initial strength and cell type. Stable baseline testing and controlled test conditions matter when interpreting lasting increases or decreases in transmission. The paper therefore supports treating a simple co-activity rule as limited and interpreting efficacy time courses under stated controls. It does not supply the invented numerical datasets in this packet, a universal one-hour definition of long-term plasticity, or an official curriculum duty.
